findings.finding: Same D13 opt-in launch and hang record. Adapt full-GLM mirror has the same HEAD. Published gains are against fixed k4, while our selected controller is already request/phase adaptive.
findings.decision: No new runtime patch to import.

findings.finding: Latest recipe commit adds full TP4 on September29. The full TP6 recipe remains a reference for the existing stack.

October3 full-GLM Int4-Int8Mix TP4 stack includes per-proposal confidence stopping, DSA shortcut at context <=2048, descriptor-scoped graph pad handling, split-layout MLA and dirty-L2 discard. Latest functional change resets watchdog busy-stall allowance during GPU idle.
findings.decision: Prioritize source compatibility of short DSA and current-draft-confidence stopping after ordered experiments. Current-draft-confidence differs from our acceptance-history/cost policy. Inspect L2 and graph work before proposing kernels. Keep EXL3 TP6 weights and capacity.
limitations: Source DSA explicitly permits TP4 only; requires a port and strict numerical gates for TP6.
Their 66K context, quantization and benchmark protocols differ; do not claim their reported rates as an A/B against ours.
Pad hygiene removes overhead of their own remap; our path may not have that overhead.

findings.finding: UVM leaf-page-table packing is validated upstream on the same 7.0.0-1019-nvidia-64k kernel and580.178.04 driver. Upstream profiled backing storage fell from about3.25GiB to0.218GiB versus stock64KiB UVM; reported net gain versus4KiB OS is separately1.78-1.86GiB. Serving throughput comparable.
findings.decision: Investigate a UVM-only build for our existing OS, not a Talos installation. Requires drained driver activation, allocation/readback and serving gates. No local memory gain or tok/s gain measured.

findings.finding: dgx1022.5 adopts Christopher Owen page-table packing in the open580.178.04 UVM module, plus existing ATS TLB flush patch.
findings.decision: Follow credited allocator patch; do not migrate the OS for an unmeasured throughput claim.

findings.decision: No measured inference-speed reason to update.

findings.finding: Recent commits propagate DFlash block-drop fix toTP3/6 and increase pinned TP4 KV using display carveout.
findings.decision: DFlash and display-carveout KV changes do not directly apply to retained full EXL3/MTP configuration. Preserve24GiB KV and360K context.

findings.finding: Decode-floorv7 allows runnable prefill progress when a waiting request cannot obtainKV; preserves priority behavior and validates legacy patch migration. TP2 progress cases pass; timing and temperature0 identity comparisons inconclusive due baseline drift.
findings.decision: Inspect waiting-allocation progress in our pinned scheduler before porting; preserve3072 budget. This is not evidence that our rejected small-budget policies now qualify.

findings.finding: v1.5 October3 adds up to8streams, larger verify windows with proportional memory reserve, and serial cancellation. Reported4-to8stream aggregate gains27-36percent are Flash/DFlash2 on2/3Sparks; single-stream unchanged.
findings.decision: Record developments only; no TensorFold port or claim of equivalent fullTP6 gains.

findings.finding: E35 current-draft confidence verify cap is conceptually relevant; E36 quantizes output head, outside fixed-precision plan. LatestE37 butterfly collectives all slower thanNCCL; E38 MLA-prep fusion remains no-go with about48-52us optimistic margin versus52-101ms target graphs.
findings.decision: Use draft-confidence idea as corroborating reference. Avoid rerunning butterfly/fusion just on enthusiasm; require TP6 profiles. No SparkCache import justified by our measured prefix-reuse outcome.
